verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of automated multi-interviewer panel or onsite-loop scheduling, interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution. The only scheduling mention is 'SMS scheduling and rich messaging built-in', which concerns messaging and does not show automatic panel scheduling. Automation Hub covers archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, not interview loops. Interview scheduling is a fair axis for an ATS, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
